description: This source file implements a tool for batch comparison of certificate verification results between platform and built-in verifiers, primarily used on Windows. It reads serialized proto messages representing certificate chains, performs verification using different methods, and reports differences.

classes.name: CertVerifyImpl
classes.description: Encapsulates certificate verification using a specific CertVerifyProc implementation.

methods.name: GetUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string used for network requests.

methods.name: SetUpOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Initializes network context and fetcher on a dedicated network thread.

methods.name: ShutdownOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Shuts down network context and fetcher on the network thread.

methods.name: CreateCertVerifyImplFromName
methods.description: Creates a CertVerifyImpl instance based on a given name ('platform' or 'builtin').

methods.name: PrintStats
methods.description: Outputs collected statistics about file processing and verification results.

methods.name: TrialComparisonResultToString
methods.description: Converts a TrialComparisonResult enum to a string.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the tool.

methods.name: RunCert
methods.description: Reads and processes a single certificate chain proto from input file, performs verification, and reports differences.
